(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The method of selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising: accessing a first server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on a second server computer; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

(Currently Amended) Claim 24: The system for selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, the system comprising: a first server computer; a second server computer; a client computer; and a media request broker, wherein the second server computer is a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the system further comprising circuitry for selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request.

(Currently Amended) Claim 27: The computer program product for selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, the computer program product comprising: a computer readable medium having program code embodied therewith, the program code comprising: program code for accessing a first server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; program code for adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on a second server computer; program code for ensuring the resource has a unique signature as part of its identifier; and program code for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.
